caption: The drawing depicts a four-wheeled carriage with a curved frame and large, spoked wheels that appear yellow or tan in color. The carriage features a high, curved handle at the rear and is fitted with a red cushioned seat and backrest. The main body of the carriage is primarily green with some gold detailing. Above the seat is a decorative canopy supported by two intricately shaped black vertical supports; the canopy itself is light-colored with red accents, possibly representing fabric or fringe. In the upper right corner, there is an inset diagram showing scale measurements and additional structural views of the carriage, rendered in fine lines. The drawing is bordered by a thin rectangular outline, with text at the lower left stating "DEL. 156-1 James M. Lawson." The overall background is plain and off-white.
title: Doll Carriage
